idea-plugin.name: Clockify Integration
idea-plugin.description:
Log time to Clockify directly from your JetBrains IDE — no context switching required.

Features

  • Auto-prompt after push — a dialog appears after each successful Git push so you can log time without breaking your flow.
  • Tool window — log time at any moment from the Clockify sidebar panel.
  • Pre-filled from Git — the time entry description is pre-populated with your latest commit message.
  • Workspace & project picker — select your workspace, project, and task from live dropdowns backed by the Clockify API.
  • Secure token storage — your API token is stored in the IDE's built-in credential safe, never in plain text.

Getting started

  1. Open Settings → Tools → Clockify Integration.
  2. Paste your Clockify API token (found at clockify.me → Profile → API) and click Validate.
  3. Select your default workspace and project.
  4. Push a commit — the log-time dialog will appear automatically.

This is an unofficial, community-made plugin. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or created by Clockify / CAKE.com.
